note: SIMULATED, NOT DATA. Every rover in this file is invented for the surface view: names, operators, masses, speeds, positions and routes come from scripts/build-rovers.mjs and from no mission, catalogue or measurement. Only the landing each rover is placed beside (siteId) is real. Latitude is north-positive and longitude east-positive (-180..180), degrees, in the Moon's Mean Earth / Polar Axis frame, as in landings.json. 'path' is a closed circuit: the rover drives from each point to the next in a straight line at speedMps (metres per second), and from the last point back to the first. At a point with 'stopS' it halts for that many seconds ('activity' says what for). The circuit repeats without end from 'epochUtc'; 'phaseS' is how many seconds into a lap the rover is at the epoch. 'lengthM' is the length of one lap; 'home' is the first point of the path. Routes ignore the terrain. Do not edit by hand: change the roster in the script and run npm run build-rovers.
